paragraphs: The next component should be Enterprise Backward Compatibility.
This is one of the defining characteristics of long-lived enterprise platforms.

This framework will ensure that as KoreVity evolves over many years, new capabilities never unnecessarily break existing business operations, allowing enterprises to innovate continuously while protecting previous investments and ensuring smooth long-term evolution.
This is one of the reasons platforms like Windows, Linux, Oracle Database, and IBM Mainframe have survived for decades.
They didn't survive because they changed quickly.
They survived because they changed without breaking the past.
KoreVity should follow the same philosophy.
Innovation should never force customers to rebuild everything.

sections.title: 📊 Overall Documentation Status
paragraphs: At this point, the core Enterprise Operating System specification is effectively 99% complete.

What remains is not foundational architecture but the final publication layer—the material that transforms the documentation from an engineering specification into a world-class enterprise architecture standard.
The remaining work should focus on:

These final phases won't redefine KoreVity—they will make it deployable, teachable, governable, and publishable as an enterprise-grade platform specification comparable in completeness to frameworks like TOGAF, ITIL, Kubernetes, or SAP architecture documentation, while remaining uniquely focused on an AI-native Enterprise Operating System.
lists: Reference Architecture & Blueprints – end-to-end architectural views, deployment models, logical and physical architectures.
Implementation & Adoption Framework – maturity model, rollout strategy, migration paths, governance, and operating model.
Developer & Partner Ecosystem – SDKs, extension model, APIs, plugins, marketplace, certification, and ecosystem governance.
Documentation, Standards & Appendices – glossary, naming conventions, design principles, architectural patterns, reference tables, compliance mappings, and indexes.
